scope: Partial basin-paper formalization: full abstract two-scale averaging, unconditional trajectory packing and correction products; actual infinite geometric Syracuse random series on the 3-adic integers, affine stationarity, finite cylinder law and maximal exponent; actual arithmetic endpoint tails, first-hit word/weight encoding, hitting-time classification, cycle weights, inverse-operator expansion, and full Green Dirichlet identity and finiteness; periodic convolution and the Cesaro-to-Abel implication for actual canonical cylinder masses; logarithmic cumulative bounds, scalar Green normalization, power-weight perturbation, and critical Green/harmonic implications from explicit limit hypotheses. External first-passage roots are separately replayed. Full density existence, first-hit clock laws, the weighted Dirichlet residue asymptotic, and the complete canonical-identification chain are not certified by this report. No Collatz conjecture proof is claimed.
